title: Hiroshima Atomic Bombing
description:
On August 6, 1945, the United States dropped an atomic bomb on the Japanese city of **Hiroshima** during World War II. It was the first nuclear weapon used in warfare.

The bomb, nicknamed "Little Boy," killed an estimated 70,000 to 80,000 people immediately, with tens of thousands more dying later from radiation exposure.

Three days later, a second atomic bomb was dropped on Nagasaki. Japan announced its surrender on August 15, effectively ending World War II.

Today, Hiroshima stands as a symbol of peace and the devastating consequences of nuclear warfare.
